admission.justification: Prevents spurious merge conflicts or silently dropped deferrals across concurrent leaf syncs, and is guarded by bidirectional merge and post-sync closeout tests.

applicability: Three-way structural JSON merges of ar-dependent/v1 records in crossing.py during memory syncs.
conditions: Distinct deferral IDs added on opposite sides merge cleanly in both directions without conflict.
A deferral removed on one side and unchanged on the other resolves as removed, and an empty merged list omits the deferrals key.
Differently edited deferrals sharing one ID remain an explicit crossing-conflict.
exclusions: Non-keyed record fields, which continue to merge by field name.
statement: The structural crossing merge treats DependentRecord.deferrals as a keyed list by id, merging concurrent additions in both directions without conflict, carrying one-sided resolution via 3-way delete-vs-unchanged, and omitting the deferrals key when empty.
title: Crossing merge merges DependentRecord.deferrals by ID and omits empty lists
